notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable embedded time-advance development slice to source-derived IEEE 1516.1-2025 records. The slice initializes each joined federate at the selected representation's initial time, retains a Time Advance Request until the configured callback dispatcher delivers Time Advance Grant, and exposes Query Logical Time. A separate contract traces the limited no-TSO GALT/NRG scheduler that can release TAR callbacks across federates. The restore-control contract now has two narrow process-local regressions: one returns a saved current time after a post-save advance, and another proves a saved deferred lookahead decrease changes the restored time window at a later grant. They do not establish complete save/restore semantics for time management. Umbra deliberately has no transport, TSO message delivery/order, timestamped queues, other advance modes, package support, catalog result, JUnit sidecar, protected review, or conformance claim.
